person.name: Fergus Irvine
person.tagline: Builds the tools a bank client book runs on. Runs agent fleets on Claude Code.
person.intro: Relationship manager at a global bank; I ship the dashboards and deck builders my desk uses. Seven years at sea before that. All data here is synthetic and checked against an independent recomputation.

domains.title: Financial services
domains.blurb: Built inside a global bank's securities-finance business: one master, three production releases, all synthetic here (the launch pad holds all four). Plus a deal model from public filings.

projects.name: Client Book Deck Builder, master v41
projects.what: Exposure analytics and deck builder. 13-factor peer benchmark, five-question explore surface, decks exported into the user's own PPTX template.
projects.proof: 7,014 lines, zero dependencies. 100k rows / 70 MB in ~49 s. t, F, trend and Granger-style tests, BH-adjusted. 41 builds.

projects.name: Client Exposure Dashboard, build 32
projects.what: Client-facing release of the master: monitoring and branded deck export. Deployed globally; dozens of RMs and client-service staff use it monthly.
projects.proof: 123- and 37-assertion test modules. Sanitised, it is this repo's live demo.

projects.name: EMEA Aged Receivables Dashboard, v1
projects.what: Receivables by RM and age bucket, unbilled revenue, monthly deck, fee-schedule tracker. Deployed globally to EMEA finance, billing and collections.
projects.proof: Demo from 12 synthetic source files; every figure matched a Python recomputation to the cent.

projects.name: No-install Exposure Explorer
projects.what: Drop a CSV; rank and filter lenders and borrowers. Earliest, lightest build; the global fallback.
projects.proof: 2,400-row demo CSV; KPIs and rankings matched to Python.

projects.name: Merck & Co / Pandion acquisition model
projects.what: M&A model of a $1.85bn biotech acquisition from public filings: rNPV, SOTP, comps, precedents, PPA, accretion and dilution, synergies, scenarios.
projects.proof: 751 live formulas, zero errors. Workbook by hand; documents AI-assisted.

domains.title: Personal quant and decision systems
domains.blurb: Code is being prepared for release after a secrets scan. Figures are from the suites as they stand.

projects.name: Trade Advisor
projects.what: Multi-horizon trade decision support with outcome scoring and gated execution.
projects.proof: 18-agent research run, 82 sources, ~1.2M tokens. 17-check safety suite. Live execution off by default behind 8 checks.

projects.name: equity-advisor
projects.what: Equity research CLI; the valuation engine inside Trade Advisor.
projects.proof: 115 tests in 31 files. Coverage 79% to 85% before the live gate opened.

projects.name: algo-trader-v3
projects.what: Trading pipeline in five gated stages: hypothesis, signal research, build, paper, live.
projects.proof: 129 tests, 28 ADRs. A hook blocks stage advance until the prior gate reads PASS. 10+ edges killed before capital.

projects.name: Football Predictor
projects.proof: 196 tests. RPS 0.2018 on unseen data, 15 leagues, 34,903 matches. Conclusion: no edge against the market.

projects.name: ETF Investment Simulator
projects.what: Monte Carlo comparison of 36 funds across UK brokers.
projects.proof: 100,000 paths in the browser. Survivorship and recency warnings built in.

build.title: How I build with Claude
summary: Contabo VPS (12 vCPU, 47 GB) runs headless Claude Code for agent fleets. Mac is master; cloud sessions take overnight research.
A hook forces a launch card before any agent run: three configurations, models and effort chosen fresh, usage share and finishing time. Nothing runs until I type go.
Finders write to disk, a verifier re-checks, one judge decides. Briefs are files with an output schema.
196 / 129 / 115 tests; hook-enforced gates; kill scoreboard; pre-registration and held-out controls.
Branch per task, draft PRs with a merge order, ADRs, HANDOVER and STATE files in every project.
